component.name: FerroMix2
component.summary: Voicemeeter-style virtual audio mixer for PipeWire

description.p: FerroMix2 is a Voicemeeter-Potato-class virtual mixer for Linux, built on PipeWire and WirePlumber. It routes any application to any hardware output or virtual microphone, keeps routes alive by application name so a call ending doesn't destroy your patch, refuses to build the feedback loops that ruin a mix-minus setup, and runs per-strip noise-gate and compressor DSP.
Launch it and it owns PipeWire for as long as it's open; close it and every FerroMix device and link is torn down, PipeWire goes straight back to stock behavior.
Merged the daemon and GUI into a single process: launch it and it owns PipeWire directly, close it and everything is torn down cleanly. First Flatpak release.
